description: This file defines the SitemapHelperService class, which provides methods for validating sitemap paths and generating sitemap slugs within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: SitemapHelperService
classes.description: A service class for handling sitemap path validation and slug generation.

methods.name: ValidatePathAsync
methods.description: Validates a sitemap path for correctness, uniqueness, and proper formatting.

methods.name: GetSitemapSlug
methods.description: Generates a URL slug for a sitemap based on its name.
